source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 789 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-789.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 789 was established by Ordinance No. 27226, passed by the Dallas City Council on June 11, 2008. (Ord. 27226)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-789.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 789 is established on property located at the southeast corner of C.F. Hawn Freeway and Interstate 20. The size of PD 789 is approximately 7.3 acres. (Ord. 27226)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-789.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a nonresidential zoning district. (Ord. 27226)

sections.title: Exhibit
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-789.104. EXHIBIT.

The following exhibit is incorporated into this article: Exhibit 789A: development plan. (Ord. 27226)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-789.105. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Development and use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 789A). If there is a conflict between the text of this article and the development plan, the text of this article controls. (Ord. 27226)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-789.106. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

(a) Except as provided in this section, the only main uses permitted are those main uses permitted in the CS Commercial Service District, subject to the same conditions applicable in the CS Commercial Service District, as set out in Chapter 51A. For example, a use permitted in the CS Commercial Service District only by specific use permit (SUP) is permitted in this district only by SUP; a use subject to development impact review (DIR) in the CS Commercial Service District is subject to DIR in this district; etc.

(b) The following main use is permitted by right:

-- Drive-in theater. (Ord. 27226)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-789.107. ACCESSORY USES.

(a) As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A- 4.217.

(b) The following accessory uses are not permitted:

-- Accessory community center (private). -- Accessory medical/infectious waste incinerator. -- Home occupation. -- Private stable.

(c) The following accessory use is permitted by SUP only:

-- Accessory helistop. (Ord. 27226)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-789.108. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations in Division 51A-4.400. If there is a conflict between this section and Division 51A- 4.400, this section controls.)

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section, the yard, lot, and space regulations for the CS Commercial Service District apply.

(b) Residential proximity slope. Residential proximity slope regulations do not apply to the drive-in theater screens.

(c) Height. Except as provided in this subsection, maximum structure height is 45 feet. Maximum drive-in theater screen height is 51 feet. (Ord. 27226)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-789.109. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

(a) Consult the use regulations in Division 51A 4.200 for the specific off street parking and loading requirements for each use.

(b) All surface parking areas and maneuvering areas must be on a compacted sub-grade, and must consist of either:

(1) concrete paving;

(2) hot mix asphalt paving which consists of a binder and surface course; or

(3) a material which has equivalent characteristics of the above and has the approval of the building official. (Ord. 27226)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-789.110. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. 27226)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-789.111. LANDSCAPING.

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section, landscaping must be provided in accordance with Article X.

(b) Drive-in theater use. Before the issuance of a building permit, a landscape plan must be submitted to and approved by the building official. The landscape plan must include the following:

(1) One design standard from the list in Section 51A-10.126.

(2) One site tree for every 6,000 square feet of lot area.

(3) Required street trees must be provided along the perimeter of the Property as close to the C.F. Hawn Freeway service road curb line as practical, and must be located a minimum of 10 feet from overhead utility lines.

(4) Required street trees and site trees must be from the following species:

(A) Loblolly Pine (planted 20 feet on center).

(B) Austrian Pine (planted 20 feet on center).

(C) Eastern Red Cedar (planted 20 feet on center).

(D) Italian Cypress (planted 10 to 15 feet on center).

(E) Thuja Green Giant (planted 10 to 15 feet on center).

(F) Leyland Cypress (planted 10 to 15 feet on center).

(5) Trees with a caliper of six inches or greater, existing on June 11, 2008, that are between the western Property line and the western fence line, must be verified by a tree survey and preserved.

(c) Maintenance. Plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. (Ord. 27226)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-789.112. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for business zoning districts in Article VII. (Ord. 27226)

sections.title: Drive-In Theater Operations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-789.113. DRIVE-IN THEATER OPERATIONS.

The following applies to a drive-in theater use:

(1) To avoid traffic hazards, start times for showings on screens 1, 2, and 3 must be staggered a minimum of 15 minutes apart.

(2) From June 1 to September 1, hours of operation are limited to 9:00 p.m. to 1:30 a.m., Monday through Sunday. At all other times of the year, hours of operation are limited to 5:00 p.m. to 12:00 a.m., Monday through Sunday.

(3) A minimum of three security personnel must be present during hours of operation. (Ord. 27226)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-789.114. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) Ingress and egress to the Property is limited to two points on C.F. Hawn Freeway, as shown on the development plan.

(b) An eight-foot-high screening fence around the perimeter is required, as shown on the development plan.

(c) The Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(d) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 27226)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-789.115. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit to authorize work, or a certificate of occupancy to authorize the operation of a use, until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 27226)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-789.116. ZONING MAP.

PD 789 is located on Zoning Map No. N-11. (Ord. 27226)
